novel_features.name: Cross-park date planner
novel_features.description: See, for each date, whether Tokyo Disneyland and DisneySea tickets are on sale, few left, sold out or not yet on sale, what each ticket costs, and the hours: official for TDL/TDS (published months only), third-party ThemeParks.wiki for USJ and Fuji-Q (about one month ahead).
novel_features.rationale: Joins per-ticket TDR calendar data in Japanese and English with third-party USJ and Fuji-Q hours and keeps unknowns explicit (USJ price and Express Pass are null with a reason).
novel_features.why_it_matters: Use it before recommending a park date; it gives sale status, price and hours with source fetch times instead of guesses. Beyond the sources' horizons it returns null with a reason.

novel_features.name: Typical waits from local history
novel_features.description: See median and p75 waits per ride by weekday and hour from your own recorded snapshots, with sample counts and date span.
novel_features.rationale: queue-times has no historical API; only a local snapshot history can answer typical-wait questions honestly.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Use it to compare weekdays or hours for specific rides without inventing a crowd forecast. It is empty until snapshot has run on a schedule; thin cells show insufficient.

novel_features.name: Wait snapshot recorder
novel_features.description: Record the current waits for the Japan parks into a local history that later commands read.
novel_features.rationale: Append-only history with dedupe on source update time does not exist in any source.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Run it from your own scheduler (see the cron example in the README) so typical and waits have history.

novel_features.name: Live waits against your typical
novel_features.description: On the park day, see live waits next to the usual wait for this weekday and hour from your own snapshots, with sample counts.
novel_features.rationale: Joins live Queue-Times data with your local history; Queue-Times has no history API.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Use it on the park day to see which rides are below their usual wait; the usual-wait columns appear only after snapshot has recorded history for this weekday and hour.

narrative.headline: Compare park dates and ride waits for Tokyo Disney Resort, Universal Studios Japan and Fuji-Q from source-backed data.
narrative.value_prop: `dates` shows Tokyo Disney Resort ticket sale status and price per ticket type with official TDR hours and third-party (ThemeParks.wiki) USJ and Fuji-Q hours for each date. `waits`, `snapshot` and `typical` turn Queue-Times live waits into a local history with honest sample sizes. Read-only: it never buys tickets.

quickstart.comment: See the park ids and which sources cover each park.
Compare sale status, price and hours for candidate dates.

troubleshoots.symptom: dates shows not_yet_on_sale for a date
troubleshoots.fix: TDR sells each date two months ahead from 14:00 JST; check the sale_opens_at field and run dates again after that time.
Run japan-theme-parks-pp-cli snapshot on a schedule (for example every 15 minutes from cron) to collect more samples.

troubleshoots.symptom: dates shows USJ or Fuji-Q hours as null
troubleshoots.fix: The third-party ThemeParks.wiki schedule reaches only about one month ahead (not the two-month TDR sale window); ask again closer to the date or check the official park site.

narrative.when_to_use: Use this CLI to choose a Tokyo Disneyland or Tokyo DisneySea date from official per-ticket sale status, price and hours; to see Universal Studios Japan and Fuji-Q hours for about the next month (third-party ThemeParks.wiki data); and to compare live Queue-Times waits with waits you recorded yourself.
anti_triggers: Buying, holding or adding tickets to a cart
USJ dated Studio Pass price or Express Pass availability (not public outside the queued web store)

recipes.title: Which DisneySea dates are still on sale
recipes.explanation: Keep only DisneySea dates with a ticket on sale or few left; months TDR has not published yet return no rows.

recipes.title: Record waits from cron
recipes.explanation: Append one snapshot per park to the local history.

recipes.title: Usual Saturday morning waits
recipes.explanation: Median and p75 per ride with sample count and date span. Needs earlier snapshot runs; cells under --min-samples (default 6) show insufficient.
